architecture_notes.compact_cnn: 64/128/192 channels; kernels 15/9/5; stride 2 per block; global pooling; dense 64 then 5
architecture_notes.resnet1d: Eight residual basic blocks in four stages; widths 16/32/64/128; stem kernel 7 stride 2 and max pool
architecture_notes.inception_time: CPU variant: learned depthwise kernel-15 stride-4 stem; six inception modules; 16 filters per branch; kernels 9/19/39; residual connection every 3 modules

hyperparameter_policy: Fixed a priori settings. No hyperparameter search or architecture selection using validation accuracy; widths and stem chosen using synthetic-input CPU timing only. Validation is used for early stopping, thresholds, and logistic C selection.
loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with train-only negative/positive class weights
ablation: Unweighted compact CNN using the same seeds and settings; fixed 0.5 versus validation-selected thresholds for each model
test_policy: Do not read test prediction performance until all trained checkpoints, validation thresholds, and model selection are frozen. Evaluate each frozen artifact once; saved predictions support later plots and interval calculations.
